description: Five games, one service, one rules-as-data kernel: Pig and Farkle (hold-or-roll / dice-set-scoring, each with a bot opponent that plays the published math), Yacht (5 dice, 3 rolls, 13 categories), Chutes & Ladders (the classic 100-square race as a board graph, with the live exact finish-turn distribution computed and shown), and Fair Spin (a practice slot machine that shows computed RTP, per-symbol hit odds, and expected loss per 100 spins permanently, never behind a click). Daily-seeded per game, earn-only, no wagering, kind design.
statusNote: seedPolicy is on-demand at this top level, not daily-utc: the front door (/) is a shelf page linking to five independently-seeded games (each daily-seeded under its own parlor:<gameId>, per README), with no single canonical today's-seed for the entry as a whole -- same reasoning as cartridgeWrapped below. cartridgeWrapped is false at this top level pending independent validation -- each of the five sub-games (src/games/{pig,farkle,yacht,chutes,reels}) carries its own cartridge.mts/manifest.mts wrapping @red-cup-engineering/parlor-kernel/replay#buildCartridge, but this catalog-entry.json covers one service directory with one replayVerifier field, which cannot honestly point at five separate per-game verifiers at once.
